rationale: Distribution family choice matters for tail probabilities: NB/hurdle-lognormal beats normal for yards ladders.
result: yards: mu-binned empirical scale family wins (rec Brier 0.1009 vs normal 0.1024; only family with uniform PIT; P(rec>=100) 7.1% vs 7.0% obs; normal 4.7%); passing yards: censored normal; counts (targets/receptions/carries): negbin (empirical over-predicts count tails 1.5-2.3x); attempts/completions: normal; pass TD/INT: poisson; TDs under-dispersed: count families under-predict 1+ by 2-3 pts and over-predict 3+ -> anytime TD needs a direct binary model; two-stage opportunity x efficiency MC never beats direct fit with weak projections
notes: Family choice moves mean Brier 1-3% but tail probabilities 1.5-3x. Re-test once real opportunity projections replace EWMA. See research/player_distributions/RESULTS.md
